name: Cursed Blood ruptures Taldaram's Torment onto nearby enemies (#3131)
contract: Cursed Blood 707435 has a single effect in Spell.dbc: SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA with aura 354, BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = 100 (the whole hit, "an additional time"), TriggerSpell Cursed Blood 707708 and the record's own ProcChance 20, which is the $h the description renders. 707708 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with BasePoints 0, TargetA 6 plus TargetB 16 over radius index 8 (5 yards), i.e. the target and everything hostile around it. Aura 354 has no AuraEffectHandler entry, no AuraEffect::HandleProc case and is not an isTriggerAura, and 707435's own ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr generated no SpellProcEntry and the talent did nothing. Every Taldaram's Torment rank (800772, 802568-802573, 802580 - the only family-26 records with SpellFamilyFlags (0, 0, 2097152)) is a bleed: effect 0 is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE at a 3000 ms amplitude over duration index 8 (15000 ms), so five ticks per application, and none of the eight ranks has a direct damage effect. "Damage dealt by Taldaram's Torment" is therefore periodic damage and the proc belongs on PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC. 802580 is the rank a level-80 character owns. The harness provides no statistical test, so the assertion is "at least once in N trials": four victims times five ticks times two applications is 40 independent 20% rolls, and 0.8^40 is 1.3e-4, i.e. a false failure under 0.1%. The bystander is never targeted and the caster deals it no other damage, so any drop in its health is the rupture splashing off a neighbour; all five creatures converge into melee contact with the caster, which keeps them inside 707708's five-yard radius.
